labels.text: Your last payment did not go through

S83.14.needs: A signed-in managed account whose subscription status is past_due, unpaid or incomplete. Getting that status is not described in the code; a Free or local/BYOK session never shows this text.
S83.14.note: The warning covers renewal or past-due states shown on /usage only. The code has no checkout-failure message in the CLI, so the 'checkout' part of Expected was not found. The 402 error path (usage_summary.rs:321) shows a similar message when usage fetch fails, which is a second place the text appears.
steps: Sign in to a managed (cloud) account with agi login, then start the agi session.
Look under the 'Account usage' heading for a line 'Subscription: past due' (or unpaid or incomplete).
Check that the line 'Your last payment did not go through, so this subscription is past due...' appears.
Check that 'Update your payment method in Settings > Billing:' is followed by a link to the billing page.
Compare with Expected: the user is told clearly and shown how to fix it.
S83.14.where: Type /usage in the agi session (REPL or TUI). The 'Account usage' block lists 'Subscription: <status>' and, when the status is past_due, unpaid or incomplete, a payment-failed warning with a Settings > Billing link.
